title: O002-H1 Prior-Report Lag-Depth Robustness / Measurement-Inertia Attack
purpose: Test whether the dominance of the immediate prior self-report reflects a longer-lived affect-state signal or mainly near-target annotation/joystick persistence, and determine whether physiology gains incremental value as prior-report information is moved farther from the future target.

construction.lag0: Current row prior same-axis report, originally mean over anchor-5s to anchor-1s; target is anchor to anchor+5s. Approximate gap to target = 1s.
construction.lag1: Previous anchor's frozen prior report within the same subject×video sequence. Because anchors are 10s apart, this corresponds to approximately current anchor-15s to anchor-11s. Approximate gap to target = 11s.
construction.lag2: Two anchors back within the same subject×video sequence, approximately current anchor-25s to anchor-21s. Approximate gap to target = 21s.
construction.rule: No interpolation or new label extraction. Lagged predictors are deterministic shifts of the already frozen O002 prior-report variable within subject×video after sorting by time_norm.

evaluation: Leave-one-subject-out. Inner GroupKFold tuning on training subjects only.
models: phys_lag0 = context + lag0 + exact 29 frozen peripheral features
phys_lag1 = context + lag1 + exact 29 frozen peripheral features
phys_lag2 = context + lag2 + exact 29 frozen peripheral features
learner: Ridge regression; alphas [0.1,1,10,100,1000]; standardization/imputation fit on training folds only.
uncertainty: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples over subject-level MAE differences.

primary_diagnostics.immediate_advantage: MAE(prior_lag1)-MAE(prior_lag0); positive means the near-target report has extra predictive advantage over the 11s-gap report.

interpretation_rules.PERSISTENCE_BEYOND_IMMEDIATE_REPORT: lag1 and/or lag2 context-vs-prior CI strictly above zero. Supports a temporally extended state-persistence signal, though still not pure psychological inertia.
interpretation_rules.NEAR_REPORT_ONLY: lag0 improves context but lag1 and lag2 do not. Strong warning that immediate baseline dominance may be dominated by annotation/joystick persistence.
interpretation_rules.PHYSIOLOGY_EMERGES_WITH_OLDER_PRIOR: physiology increment CI is non-positive at lag0 but strictly positive at lag1 or lag2. Supports redundancy with recent report rather than absence of physiological information.
interpretation_rules.NO_PHYSIOLOGY_INCREMENT_ACROSS_LAGS: all physiology increment CIs fail to be strictly positive. Strengthens a broad short-horizon incremental-utility negative result.

firewall: This is a robustness/measurement attack, not a confirmatory theory-of-feeling experiment.
Lagged self-report remains a behavioral measurement and can still contain annotation mechanics, reaction delay, and slow label dynamics.
No causal inference from physiology to feeling and no phenomenal/consciousness inference.
Do not rename report persistence as affective inertia unless the lag-depth pattern supports it and measurement alternatives remain acknowledged.
external_rationale: CASE annotations are joystick-generated continuous traces and the released interpolated stream was linearly interpolated to a fixed 50ms grid.
Continuous affect literature documents annotator reaction lag and slow/smoothed label dynamics; therefore immediate prior-label baselines require a measurement-inertia attack.
